title: Amazon Accused of Fraud
subtitle: Lawsuit Alleges Amazon Manipulated Ad Prices
excerpt: Amazon Accused of Manipulating Ad Prices
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit that alleges the company manipulated ad prices to gain billions of dollars.

Amazon's Response

Amazon responded to the lawsuit, arguing that the US Federal Trade Commission misunderstood the company's ad market.

The lawsuit is a challenge for Amazon, which needs to prove it did not manipulate ad prices for profit.

With information from BBC News.
